Title: IDisplayService - UI Display Service
Summary: Service for showing dialogs, toast notifications, and navigation in the Blazor UI. Implemented by DisplayService which requires BootstrapBlazor services.
Content:
## IDisplayService

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Components.Core`

### Purpose
UI service for showing dialogs, toasts, and navigation. Kernel-locked.

### Methods

#### ShowModal<TComponent>(ResultDialogOption option, Dialog? dialog = null)
Shows a modal dialog with a Blazor component that implements `IResultDialog`.
Returns `DialogResult`.

#### ShowModal(string title, string content, ResultDialogOption? option = null, Dialog? dialog = null)
Shows a simple text modal dialog.

#### ShowToast(ToastOption option, ToastContainer? toastContainer = null)
Shows a custom toast notification.

#### ShowErrorToast(string? title = null, string? content = null, bool autoHide = true)
Shows an error toast.

#### ShowWarnToast(string? title = null, string? content = null, bool autoHide = true)
Shows a warning toast.

#### ShowSuccessToast(string? title = null, string? content = null, bool autoHide = true)
Shows a success toast.

#### ShowInfoToast(string? title = null, string? content = null, bool autoHide = true)
Shows an info toast.

#### NavigateTo(string url)
Navigates to a URL.

### Implementation
`DisplayService` in `Cyrena.Components.Runtime` implements this interface. It requires `DialogService`, `ToastService`, and `NavigationManager` to be set via `SetServices()`.

### Registration
```csharp
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IDisplayService, DisplayService>();
```

### Related
- `DisplayService` - Implementation
- `ComponentAssistantsPlugin` - Registers the service and toolbar components
